lines: It seems this world still wants to tame me
Fine, have it your way — I'll struggle beautifully
Let's kiss while we watch each other's hourglasses run
Let's meet at the place farthest from goodbye
I hated a world built out of dictionary words
Inside a kaleidoscope, on a certain August morning
You'd blush in front of me, then put on a cool face
With a smile straight out of this world's textbook
The time has finally come — everything until yesterday was just the prologue's prologue
Skim if you have to, but from here on, it's me
With experience and knowledge, and my courage gone moldy at the edges
At a speed never seen before, I dive toward you
In my drowsiness, with a lukewarm cola
I dreamed of somewhere other than here
Outside the classroom window
In the mornings, carried along in a swaying train
Even how to love carried your scent
Even my way of walking carried that laughter
All of you, someday bound to vanish
Burning it into these eyes of mine
It's no longer a right — I think it's a duty
Words like fate, like the future — no matter how far they reach their hands
We fall in love in a place they'll never touch
Even the clock's hands move on, glancing sideways at us two
That world — the two of us, for a lifetime, no, through every chapter
We'll live it through
